integrity: The proof is analytic. Numerical checks are supplementary. Pointwise coherence/negativity relations known in broader settings are treated as prior work; the claimed contribution is the exact restricted-volume law, purity factorization, and tube asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Restricted Hilbert–Schmidt volume on the two-dimensional GHZ cat support only; not the full many-qubit state ensemble, not Bures or other induced measures, and not a claim about genuine multipartite entanglement measures beyond bipartite negativity.
title: Exact Hilbert–Schmidt negativity law in the GHZ cat-state Bloch ball
